Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [When Digivolving] effect still activate for my opponent's Security Digimon and give them -4000 DP when my opponent doesn't have any Digimon?

Effect: [When Digivolving] 1 of your opponent's Digimon and all of your opponent's Security Digimon get -4000 DP for the turn.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When one of your red or yellow Tamers becomes suspended, 1 of your opponent's Digimon and all of your opponent's Security Digimon get -4000 DP for the turn.
